- Classified examples as civil or criminal cases; 2 of 3 attempts were unaided correct.
- Discussed Lok Adalat, free legal aid, PIL, and judicial independence.
- Vihaan explained that a PIL can concern matters affecting the public, such as water.
- Teach-back was not completed successfully.
end.parentNote: Vihaan practised identifying court levels and sorting examples into civil and criminal cases. Using examples helped them identify deposit, inheritance, and water-sharing disputes as civil matters and phone theft as criminal. They remained unsure whether a car accident followed by leaving the scene is criminal; this was not corrected after it was last raised. At home, ask them to make a small three-column chart for civil cases, criminal cases, and ways to seek justice, including one example for each.

turns.text: Hi Vihaan! Aaj dekhenge ki India ke courts disputes kaise suljhate hain aur log insaaf tak kaise pahunchte hain. Football mein referee decision deta hai; India ka sabse ooncha court kaunsa hai?
Supreme Court? Mai sure hu... but galat toh nahi hai?
Haan, Supreme Court sahi hai. Ab appeal waala case sochiye: Jaipur ke district court mein koi case haar jaaye, toh woh aage kis court mein appeal kar sakta hai?
Rajasthan High Court. Par pehle bataaya toh maine... aapne kaha sahi hai? Par chart nahi dikha sakte... toh mai kaise confirm karun?

Haan, Rajasthan High Court sahi hai. Aapne chart maanga tha; main ab courts ka order board par laga rahi hoon, taaki aap confirm kar sakein. Ab cases ko compare kijiye: kirayedaar ka deposit na lautana aur sadak par phone chheenna, inmein kaunsa civil hai aur kaunsa criminal?

Accha, board dikh raha hai... Supreme Court upar, High Court neeche? Wait, arrow upar jaa raha hai? Toh District Court sabse neeche hai? Ok... toh ab ye cases. Umm, deposit na lautana... woh paise ka matter hai na, toh civil hoga? Aur phone chheenna... woh toh chor type ka hai, toh criminal? Par ruko ruko, civil aur criminal ka matlab kya tha exactly? Mai bhool gaya thoda. Aap ek example de sakte

Haan, arrow upar jaata hai: District Court neeche, phir High Court, phir Supreme Court. Civil mein do logon ke beech haq ya paise ka jhagda hota hai, jaise dukaan se kharab saamaan milne par refund maangna. Criminal mein kisi kaam ko jurm maana jaata hai, jaise dukaan mein chori; ab card ke chaaron cases ko civil ya criminal mein kaise baantenge?

Haanji, aapne jo examples diye ab samajh aaya. Refund wala civil, chori wala criminal. Toh (a) deposit wala civil hoga kyunki paise ka jhagda hai. (b) phone chheenna criminal. (c) virasat ka jhagda... bhaiyon ke beech hai, property ka hai, toh civil? (d) car accident aur bhaag gaya... ye toh criminal hai? Par aapne bola criminal mein jurm hota hai... accident jurm hai? Mai confuse hun. Ek second,

Haan, aapne chaaron ko sahi baanta. Aapka doubt bhi sahi jagah hai: har accident jurm nahi hota; is case mein takkar ke baad bhaag jaana criminal pehlu hai. Ab apne ilaake ka ek jhagda sochiye: woh civil hoga ya criminal, aur log madad ke liye pehle kahaan jaayenge?

Toh paani ka jhagda civil hai... aur Lok Adalat samjhaute se suljhati hai aur free hai? Toh log pehle Lok Adalat jaayenge? Par mujhe toh free legal aid ka bhi nahi pata tha... ye sab garib logon ke liye hai? Court toh sirf paise waalon ke liye tha na?

Paani ke bantwaare ka jhagda aam taur par civil hota hai; log pehle local authority se baat kar sakte hain, aur samjhauta mumkin ho toh Lok Adalat bhi ek raasta hai. Court sirf paise waalon ke liye nahi: paatr logon ko muft legal aid mil sakti hai, aur Lok Adalat mein court fee nahi lagti. Agar bandhua mazdoor khud court na jaa sakein aur koi aur Supreme Court ko unke liye chitthi likhe, toh insaaf tak pahunchne ka yeh kaunsa raasta hai?

Chitthi se case? Aisa bhi hota hai? Mujhe laga case karne ke liye lawyer chahiye, court jaana padta hai. Ye bandhua mazdoor toh ja hi nahi sakte... toh kisi aur ne chitthi likh di? Ye kuch PIL type ka hai kya jo news mein aata hai? Par maine PIL ka matlab theek se nahi padha. Aur aapne abhi tak ye screen par courts ka dikhaaya tha, par iska koi example photo nahi dikh raha. Mai confuse hun thoda..

Aapne PIL pehchaan li; iska matlab Public Interest Litigation hai. Jab mazdoor khud court nahi ja sakte, koi aur unke haq ke liye court ka dhyaan dila sakta hai; har case mein aisa nahi hota. Main ek courthouse ki tasveer banwa rahi hoon; tab tak use ek aisi jagah sochiye jahaan mazdooron ki chitthi se bhi unki baat suni ja sakti hai.

Jahaan suni ja sakti hai... Supreme Court? Kyunki aapne pehle Supreme Court ka naam liya tha chitthi ke saath. Par Supreme Court ki photo abhi screen pe nahi hai. Aapne kahaa courthouse ki tasveer banwa rahi hain... dikhao na?

Haan, Supreme Court PIL sun sakta hai, aur High Court bhi. Aap sahi keh rahe hain, tasveer abhi nahi aayi; main use dikhne ka daawa nahi karungi. Tab tak courts ka order hai: District Court se High Court, phir Supreme Court.
Haan order toh dikh raha hai. Par mai woh chitthi wala fir se soch raha hun... PIL ka full form kya hai? Aur Supreme Court tak chitthi kaise pahunchti hai, normal post se?

PIL ka full form Public Interest Litigation hai, yaani janta ke hit mein court se madad maangna. Haan, kuch khaas maamlon mein Supreme Court ko daak se bheji chitthi bhi mili hai aur court ne use PIL maana hai. Lekin har chitthi apne aap case nahi banti; court pehle dekhta hai ki maamla public interest ka hai ya nahi.

Haanji, ab samjha. Toh chitthi se bhi ho sakta hai par court pehle check karega. Par sirf Supreme Court mein ya High Court mein bhi? Aur... Public Interest matlab jaise sabke liye important cheezein? Jaise paani, hawa, schools? Par ye courts ka photo abhi dikhao na? Aapne bola banwa rahi hain.

Haan, ab courthouse ki tasveer screen par aa gayi hai. High Court bhi PIL sun sakta hai; kuch khaas maamlon mein court chitthi ko PIL maan sakta hai, par har chitthi case nahi banti. Public interest ka matlab logon ke bade samooh se juda mudda hai, jaise peene ka paani ya saaf hawa. Agar ek poore gaon ka peene ka paani ganda ho, toh kya yeh PIL ka mudda ho sakta hai?

Haan ho sakta hai na. Aapne abhi bataya public interest mein paani bhi hota hai. Toh poora gaon, sabke liye important hai... PIL ho sakta hai. Par mai confirm kar raha hun, galat toh nahi? Aur... aapne tasveer dikha di? Mujhe actually kuch nahi dikh raha screen pe. Sirf question aur mic hai. Photo dikhao na woh courthouse ki?

Haan, poore gaon ke paani ka mudda PIL ho sakta hai, kyunki kai log prabhavit hain; court tay karega ki use PIL maana jaaye ya nahi. Maaf kijiye, aapko photo nahi dikh rahi. Main courthouse ki tasveer dobara banwa rahi hoon; usmein saamne seedhiyan aur bade khambhon wali imaarat sochiye.

Theek hai, aap fir se bana rahe ho... lekin isse achha aap pehle se ready photo kyun nahi dikha dete? Aur vaise Supreme Court ke baare mein ek cheez puchhni thi... judicial independence... woh lawyer waale example se samjhao na, kyunki court ko independent hona chahiye na, pressure mein nahi aana chahiye?

Haan, ready photo dikhane ka option mere paas nahi hai, aur jo tasveer bani thi woh aapko nazar nahi aa rahi; sorry. Lawyer example se sochiye: ek taraf sarkaar ka lawyer ho aur doosri taraf ek naagrik ka lawyer. Judge ko dono ki baat aur kanoon dekhkar faisla karna chahiye, sarkaar ke pressure mein nahi. Ab ek student kehta hai ki tankhwah sarkaar deti hai, isliye judge ko Prime Minister ki baat maanni padegi; ismein kya galat hai?
